title: Teacher who sexually abused pupil back in Indonesia jail after BBC investigation
snippet: Mochamad Subchi Azal Tsani had been secretly released on parole in 2025, after serving less than half his sentence.

title: Residents airlifted to safety after flooding in central Chile
snippet: The Mapocho river has burst its banks after an unusually large amount of rain fell in recent days.

title: South Korea recalls Ukraine envoy over prisoner-of-war row
snippet: It is the latest in a diplomatic spat after Kyiv disclosed that two North Korean prisoners were transferred to Seoul.

title: Bear kills man in home attack near Mongolian capital
snippet: Police say the bear entered a traditional nomadic dwelling near Ulaanbaatar, killing a man and seriously injured a woman.
